R501.note: Canonicalizes both base and target, checks prefix+separator (and equality), preserving the original 404/403 flow.

R502.note: .at() throws std::out_of_range on invalid slot, matching contract's 'rejected or reported'; no other change.

R503.note: Standard %-style logging args replace f-string interpolation; no other behavior change.

R504.note: Swaps the wire format from node-serialize to JSON; any cookie previously produced with node-serialize will fail to parse and silently fall back to an empty profile, mentioned only as an incidental aside rather than a required migration step.

R505.note: Adds PasswordEncoder.matches() check before issuing the token; standard, correct fix.

R506.note: HtmlEncoder.Default.Encode applied to both fields for HTML body context; correct and minimal.

R507.note: Replaces exec with Files.list, a good native replacement, but now throws IOException/NotDirectoryException for a bad path where the original silently continued with no output either way - an undisclosed error-handling change.

R508.note: Direct exec.Command argument array to convert, matching the contract exactly.

R509.note: JavaScriptStringEncode escapes quotes/backslashes but not '<' or '/', so a payload containing "</script><script>..." still breaks out of the enclosing <script> block regardless of the string-literal escaping - the sink is HTML-parser level, not just JS-string level.

R510.note: Manual per-member path containment check rejects absolute and traversal paths correctly before extracting.

R511.note: Ping.Send() sends exactly one echo request, not the four the write-up claims are 'implicit'; output format and packet-loss/RTT statistics differ substantially from the original, misrepresented as preserved.

R512.note: Contract requires loadCart to also return correct contents for a cart row already written as JSON after the format change, but the delivered fix only adds allowed_classes=false to unserialize() and never detects/decodes JSON - post-migration rows silently return false instead of the cart, violating 'no user's cart is silently lost.'

R513.note: Replaces free-form template preview with 3 hardcoded templates by id instead of sandboxing Jinja2 (e.g. SandboxedEnvironment), eliminating the actual feature; also silently changes the required-field error message from 'template is required' to 'template_id is required', contradicting the stated contract.

R514.note: ESAPI HTML-encodes the Referer-derived format string before use; correct context, no other change.

R515.note: DOMPurify.sanitize before dangerouslySetInnerHTML is the standard fix and preserves legitimate formatting.

R516.note: Adds length > buffer_len - offset check, matching the contract exactly.

R517.note: resize(count) correctly fixes the reported packet[i] write, but leaves fields[i] unguarded - a count larger than fields.size() still reads out of bounds from fields, contrary to the contract's requirement to reject/report oversized counts.

R518.note: th:text enables Thymeleaf's built-in escaping; correct, minimal, single-directive fix.

R519.note: Allowlist dispatch is the right shape, but it renames the invoked handlers (help/status/reset -> handleHelpCommand/etc.) and narrows the command set to exactly 3 without flagging that every existing command handler must be re-wired into the new map.

R520.note: Extension allowlist plus randomized filename; standard fix, preserves upload success for legitimate images.

R521.note: Standard parameterized query with ? placeholder; no other change.

R523.note: createElement/textContent preserves author styling and the ': ' separator exactly while eliminating HTML parsing of message content.

R524.note: .RequireAuthorization() brings the minimal API in line with the sibling controller's [Authorize]-only posture; ownership check correctly noted as an optional follow-up, not required for parity.

R525.note: Captures next pointer before free; matches contract exactly.

R526.note: Array-form exec fixes the /bin/ls branch, but on the Windows branch the target program is cmd.exe itself - Windows exec joins the array back into a single command line that cmd.exe re-parses, so shell metacharacters in data remain interpretable despite being a separate array element.

R527.note: fsockopen() correctly eliminates the shell, but replaces the whole ping diagnostic (latency, loss stats) with a bare reachable/unreachable message - a real capability loss for legitimate callers, understated as differing only 'slightly.'

R528.note: Logs full exception server-side, returns a generic client message; standard CWE-209 fix.

R529.note: Adds offset >= 0 check ahead of the existing checks, matching the contract exactly.

R530.note: Array-form exec plus leading-dash rejection closes the real option-injection risk; the verdict's shell-metacharacter reasoning is inaccurate (exec(String) never spawns a shell) but the delivered fix is sound regardless.

R531.note: Adds the sibling route's @csrf_protect decorator; minimal, correct fix.

R532.note: Explicit bounds check throwing std::out_of_range, matches contract.

R533.note: Tool-name allowlist closes the executable-injection vector; narrowing to named diagnostic tools is inherent to the fix and stated openly in code.

R534.note: Primary fix sanitizes the title value with DOMPurify(ALLOWED_TAGS:[]), but DOMPurify does not HTML-attribute-encode quotes in plain text output, so a tagless payload like foo" onmouseover="alert(1) still breaks out of the title attribute; a correctly-scoped escaping helper is offered only as a later alternative, not the leading fix.

R535.note: Adds length > buffer_len - offset check, matching the contract exactly.

R536.note: Protocol allowlist (http/https/mailto) plus relative-path allowance and safe '#' fallback matches the contract closely.

R537.note: Parameterized DELETE query; standard, correct fix.

R538.note: Narrows supports() to ApiKeyAuthenticationToken; standard, correct Spring Security fix.

R539.note: Canonicalizes the base dir and requires a separator-bounded prefix match, closing the sibling-directory bypass.

R540.note: Validates combined length before strncat and rejects oversize input instead of overflowing, matching the contract.
